title: OpenTrade: An open source harness for Claude + Robinhood
author: pinchofsoma
selftext:
We built a completely open-source trading harness for Claude Code agents that use the Robinhood MCP. 

[https://github.com/OpenTradeOSS/OpenTrade](https://github.com/OpenTradeOSS/OpenTrade)

The harness lets Claude schedule itself to react to market events or timers so you can ask it things like “Monitor the dominos next to the pentagon and accordingly trade defense stocks” - Claude will setup the script and wake itself up as needed.

Feel free to open up issues and PRs on GitHub.
